title: Multimodal Content Delivery
description: Re-present core concepts through alternative formats (visual, audio, diagrammatic) to reduce language load.

actions.label: Concept Map / Diagram
actions.description: Provide a visual concept map of the topic structure and key relationships.

actions.label: Annotated Slides
actions.description: Re-share lecture slides with simplified text annotations and highlighted key points.

actions.label: Draw the Concept
actions.description: Ask student to draw or sketch how they understand the concept and submit for review.
